title: Apsis shared JSON, version 1
description: Session and listing documents emitted by `apsis -f shared-json`. Consumers must ignore unknown fields and skip block types they do not support. Removing a field or changing its meaning raises schema_version; additive fields and block types do not.

sessionDocument.description: One session: metadata, ordered entries and parse warnings.

requests.description: LM Studio request records in source order, or a logical session's discovery order. Omitted when there are none.

unattributed_summary.description: LM Studio logical-session views: body-free references to the unattributed events in each file holding the session's requests, in discovery order. Direct log views keep those events as entries instead.

listingDocument.description: Listed sessions, oldest first, with listing warnings.

sessionMetadata.description: Session metadata shared by session documents and listing rows. Unavailable values are omitted.

source.description: Source name, such as claude, codex, codex-exec, copilot, kiro-cli, kiro-ide or lmstudio.

id.description: Identifier that opens the session within its source.

thread_id.description: Codex thread identifier recorded by an exec stream, or an LM Studio logical session's client thread identifier (correlation metadata only).

created_at.description: Recorded creation time; never a filesystem time.

time_zone.description: LM Studio: the zone logged wall times are assumed to be in. The log records no zone, so every interpreted time is an assumption.

project.description: Recorded project directory, or the containing repository of an exec stream.

origin.description: First recorded client entry point or originator, exactly as recorded.

listingRow.description: A listed session: shared session metadata plus listing fields.

size_bytes.description: Session size in bytes. Omitted for LM Studio, whose sessions share log files.

request_count.description: LM Studio: requests in the logical session.

file_modified_at.description: File modification time used to order a session without a recorded creation time.

id.description: Identifier of the single source record the entry is built from. Not a tool-linking identifier and not unique within a document.

request_id.description: LM Studio: the request whose logged body the entry was translated from. Omitted on log-level entries.

supplied_context.description: LM Studio: an assistant message resent as request input, not a new completion.

unattributed.description: LM Studio: a logged response, WARN or ERROR record whose request is unknown.

source_line.description: LM Studio log-level entries: the record's one-based physical start line.

wall_time.description: LM Studio log-level entries: the record's wall time as logged, without a zone.

request.description: One LM Studio request record. Entries translated from its body name it through request_id; a request whose body was not translated has none.

session_id.description: The listed logical session the request belongs to; the request's own id for a session without a valid client thread identifier.

file.description: Logical-session views: the file holding the record, relative to the LM Studio log directory; start_line and end_line count lines in it. Omitted in direct log views, whose records all come from the one input.

request_kind.description: The client's recorded request kind, such as turn, compaction or memory.

wall_time.description: The logged wall time, without a zone.

timestamp.description: The wall time's only interpretation in the assumed zone. Omitted when it has none or several.

body_state.description: Why the body was not translated.

parameters.description: Remaining top-level body fields as logged, including tools, sampling settings, cache keys, integration headers and client metadata.

context_discontinuity.description: The logged input does not extend the previous request in the same logical session.

prior_prefix_count.description: Leading logged items repeated unchanged from the previous request in the same logical session.

response_attribution.description: Whether a logged response is tied to this request. Always unknown for the supported log grammar.

unattributedSummary.description: Body-free reference to the unattributed events in one file holding a logical session's requests. Inspect the file itself for their content; the events are not claimed for the session.

file.description: Path relative to the LM Studio log root.

next_file.description: The next discovered file, which may hold later events. Omitted for the last file.

lines.description: Start line of each unattributed event in file.

incomplete.description: The item started but never completed.

truncated.description: The source cut some of this content, such as LM Studio's <Truncated in logs> marker. The remaining text is kept as logged.

id.description: Links the call to its tool_result.

input.description: Tool input as recorded; any JSON value.

exit_code.description: Recorded command exit code; omitted when unrecorded.

event_type.description: Source event or item type without a specialised translation.

payload.description: The event's parsed payload; any JSON value.

basis.description: What the counters measure, such as thread_total_at_turn_completion.

counters.description: Counters in source key order; values are any JSON value.

extensionBlock.description: A block type added after this schema was published. Consumers skip types they do not support.

warning.description: A non-fatal problem. The one-based position key names its unit: a physical line, a Kiro IDE chat message or a Kiro IDE execution-detail action.

code.description: Warning kind. Later versions may add codes.

source.description: Listing warnings: the source that produced the warning.
